descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
They told you it didn't exist.

Eighty miles of desert, one gate, and no record that you were ever here. Walk in past the guard post, find the freight elevator, and go down. Hangar 18 is only the first floor.

Four hand-built levels, each one deeper and worse than the last: the floodlit compound at dusk, the hangar with the recovered craft still on its pad, the containment wing lined with specimen tanks, and the research lab where whatever they recovered stopped being a specimen.

You carry two pistols. They are all you get.

FEATURES

- Four full levels connected by working freight elevators, each one sealed until you have cleared the floor you are standing on.
- Two kinds of alien, and they sound different in the dark. You will learn which one is coming before you see it.
- Dual-wield automatic pistols with real recoil, muzzle flash and ejecting brass.
- Room-scale movement with snap turn and comfort options throughout.
- No player death. Getting hit pushes you back; it never sends you to a menu.

Built for Quest 3 and Quest 3S.
